edges: Curnutt was employed on a contingency basis for a legal case.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Attorneys protect themselves by putting the agreements in writing.
The attorney has a duty of disclosure which is crucial in bankruptcy cases.
The court may impose sanctions on an attorney for willfully disregarding fiduciary obligations under disclosure rules.
The attorney and client have an agreement regarding the scope of representation.
An attorney may represent a new client against a former client only if no confidential information relevant to the new representation is received from the former client.
The Oklahoma Supreme Court cited the Illinois case of Roe with approval.
Contingent fees are considered an asset of the partnership in which the estate of a deceased partner is entitled to participate.

edges: Upon Curnutt's death, the client employed and paid other attorneys.
